d.title: Bocchi the Rock!: Gotou Futari no Onee-chan Kansatsu Nikki
d.en: Bocchi the Rock!: Futari Gotou's Big Sister Observation Diary
d.jp: ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！ ごとうふたりのおねえちゃんかんさつにっき
d.synopsis: This is a special program where we look back on the recent daily life of the main character, Hitori Gotou, from the observation of her younger sister, Futari Gotou.
